Your starred watchlist is securely saved on this device. To sync across all your phones and laptops, you can connect your free Google Cloud Client ID.
3-Minute Setup:
1. Visit Google Cloud Console.
2. Under OAuth Client ID, add https://stockerboard.com to Authorized JavaScript Origins.
3. Paste your Client ID into StockMe/core/config/stockerboard_auth_config.json.
4. Click "Publish to stockerboard.com".
